messages:
Maria (growth): kickoff — thinking out loud: run a 4-week Bootcamp -> Activation playbook tied to a single webinar + cohort workshops. idea: give attendees free credits + curated prompt templates + a lightweight benchmark challenge to drive first 5 meaningful requests. goals: increase 7-day conversion, reduce time-to-first-success, gather benchmark narratives for landing posts.

Kevin (content): love it. can we keep the benchmark focused on one vertical (e.g., product copywriting) so the landing/LP and webinar are really targeted? that’ll make the case studies cleaner.

Olivia (events): dates? i can book a webinar slot w/ 2 follow-up hands-on sessions (30m each). prefer tues/wed evenings PT for max attendance. also we should have a partner for demo examples.

Maria (growth): propose kickoff webinar week of 2024-11-11, follow-ups 11-13 and 11-20. landing page draft: https://go.redwood.ai/bootcamp (placeholder). LP should highlight: free credits, 3 prompt templates, step-by-step benchmark, and an office-hours sign-up.

Sam (analytics): KPI checklist: registration -> attended -> claimed credits -> first 5 requests -> retained after 7 days. tracking: UTM, event:credit_claimed, event:first_5_requests. sample tracking snippet for engineers: 
```
POST /events
{
  "user_id": "<user>",
  "event": "credit_claimed",
  "properties": {"source":"bootcamp_lp","utm":"bootcamp-nov"}
}
```

Jordan (product): we should bundle a recommended model + quantization profile so participants get predictable perf/cost. happy to provide a one-click config for Dedicated/Hosted routes.

Kevin (content): i can draft webinar script + 3 short benchmark prompts (A/B test variants). will also write 2 launch posts: one benchmark narrative, one quickstart story. rough titles: 'From zero to useful: 5 prompts that unlock product copywriting' and 'Bootcamp: ship a feature with LLM assistance in under an hour'.

Olivia (events): signup flow question — do we gate credits to attendees only or give a smaller free-credit teaser to registrants? my vote: gate full credits to attendees, 10 free tokens to registrants to increase conversions.

Maria (growth): agreed. gate full credits (50 USD equivalent) to attendees who complete the post-webinar micro-task (submit 1 benchmark run). registrants get 10 credits. also run an activation nudge email 24h after webinar with templates.

Sam (analytics): segmentation: new signups / existing trialers / returning users. important to route existing trialers to a special cohort that gets tailored templates (higher activation bar). i'll wire queries.

Kevin (content): re: messaging iterations — propose 3 subject lines + 2 body variants for the 24h nudge. we'll A/B the subject + CTA. sample subject ideas: 'Your Bootcamp credits are waiting' / 'Ship useful copy with 3 prompts' / 'Quick hands-on: redeem 50 credits'.

Olivia (events): can marketing ops add an auto-grant workflow? i.e., attendee list -> backend job grants credits -> success email with prompt pack + benchmark link. growth-bot, can you remind ops on Monday?

growth-bot: reminder scheduled for 2024-10-28 09:00 PT to ping marketing-ops about auto-grant workflow.

Jordan (product): one more: capture one-line success quotes during follow-ups (micro case studies) — that'll feed the benchmark narrative and landing post. make a simple survey after the workshop: did you ship something? one-liner + screenshot optional.

Maria (growth): next steps: Kevin to draft copy & prompts by 2024-10-30; Olivia to book webinar + sessions by 2024-10-29; Sam to define tracking events & segmentation by 2024-10-31; Jordan to provide recommended runtime config by 2024-10-31. i'll own cohort orchestration and post-webinar nurture sequences.

Kevin (content): noted, i'll drop drafts in #marketing-drafts and ping here when ready.

Olivia (events): added tasks to my calendar. can we have a quick sync on 2024-10-29 10:00 PT?

Maria (growth): 10:00 PT works for me. Sam?

Sam (analytics): yes. will bring initial funnel dashboard mock.

Jordan (product): can attend first 15m.

Maria (growth): awesome — small launch test, focus on product-copy benchmark, gated credits for attendees, 24h activation nudge, and 2 post-launch benchmark narratives. tagging next-week owners above. :rocket: :memo:

Kevin (content): :thumbsup:

Olivia (events): :party-parrot:

Sam (analytics): ✅

growth-bot: task digest created: [grant-workflow, dashboard, copy-drafts, webinar-booking, runtime-config].
